# Reference-derived parity fixtures

Fixture files in this directory must identify the immutable upstream revision and exact source path or data section used to derive each expected result. Store minimal inputs and expected values, never copied implementation code or unreviewed game assets.

The active revision lock is documented in `docs/parity/reference-lock.md`.

`weapons.json` records the sixteen configurable fields and canonical checksums for the default and Realistic tables. Expected values only; no copied upstream source.
